questions.text: Full name
Date of birth
Best phone number to reach you
Preferred contact method
Reason for your visit
Please describe the reason for your visit
Any current concerns (pain, swelling, bleeding, sensitivity)? Describe in your own words.
When was your last dental visit?
Previous dental treatments (fillings, crowns, root canals, extractions, braces, implants)
Are you currently taking any prescription medications?
List each medication: name, strength, dose, how often, reason, and start date if known (one per line)
Have you taken antibiotics in the past 3 months?
Which antibiotic(s) and when?
Over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, supplements, or herbal products you use regularly
Any previous bad reactions or side effects from medications? Describe what happened.
Any medication changes in the past 6 months?
Are you allergic to any medications (including penicillin or other antibiotics)?
Which medication(s)? What happened during the reaction?
Are you allergic to latex?
Any other allergies (foods, materials, environmental)?
Have you ever had a bad reaction to dental or medical anesthesia?
Describe what happened
Heart or cardiovascular conditions (e.g. heart disease, murmur, pacemaker, stent)
Do you have high blood pressure or diabetes?
Respiratory conditions (asthma, COPD, sleep apnea, other)
Kidney or liver conditions
Blood or bleeding disorders; do you take blood thinners?
Immune-system conditions, HIV, or cancer history (including chemotherapy/radiation)
Neurological conditions (epilepsy, seizures, stroke, other)
Thyroid or other hormonal conditions
Any other ongoing medical diagnoses you want your dentist to know about
Previous surgeries or hospitalizations (what and when)
Any complications with anesthesia in the past?
Any implants or medical devices (joint replacement, pins, plates, etc.)?
Are you pregnant, possibly pregnant, or breastfeeding?
Do you use tobacco or vaping products?
Family history relevant to dental or medical care (optional)
Anything else your dental team should know before your visit?
I confirm this information is accurate to the best of my knowledge

review_note: Structure follows ADA medical/dental health-history guidance areas. NOT yet reviewed or approved by a licensed dentist — must be reviewed before clinical deployment.
title: Dental Pre-Visit Health History
